# AnswerIndex — Markdown Sitemap

## Machine-Readable Schemas & Manifests
- [`llms.txt`](https://answerindex.xyz/llms.txt) — High-level LLM manifest per llmstxt.org standard
- [`llms-full.txt`](https://answerindex.xyz/llms-full.txt) — Comprehensive knowledge corpus for LLM context windows
- [`ai.txt`](https://answerindex.xyz/ai.txt) — AI crawler permissions and manifest registry
- [`sitemap.xml`](https://answerindex.xyz/sitemap.xml) — Canonical XML sitemap
- [`ai-sitemap.xml`](https://answerindex.xyz/ai-sitemap.xml) — XML sitemap for AI indexing
- [`ai-entities.json`](https://answerindex.xyz/ai-entities.json) — Entity graph and semantic terminology
- [`ai-intent.json`](https://answerindex.xyz/ai-intent.json) — Query intent to URL mapping
- [`ai-schema.json`](https://answerindex.xyz/ai-schema.json) — Consolidated Schema.org JSON-LD graph
- [`rag-index.json`](https://answerindex.xyz/rag-index.json) — Knowledge chunks for RAG workflows
